The *Pasannacitta Sutta* ("A Pure Mind", Iti 21) is a short discourse in the *Ekakanipāta* of the *Itivuttaka* (PTS It 13). The sutta delivers the concise teaching that clear-mindedness and mental purity (*pasannacitta*) lead directly to rebirth in a heavenly realm.

 The reference literature passages located for this entry merely match the common lexical compound *pasannacitta* across other contexts rather than commenting on this discourse.
